AlbaSpace/index.html.Alba Space: el Star Tracker 3 en 1 para: Alba Space: the 3-in-1 Star Tracker for CubeSats. A single sensor that navigates by the stars, detects space debris and guides docking. Flight design in lab integration.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Alba Space — Un instrumento, tres mision: Alba Space — One instrument, three missions
AlbaSpace/index.html.El Star Tracker 3 en 1 para CubeSats: se: The 3-in-1 Star Tracker for CubeSats: it navigates by the stars, detects space debris and guides docking.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Escríbenos por WhatsApp sobre tu misión: Message us on WhatsApp about your mission
AlbaSpace/index.html.reúne tres funciones ópticas en un diseñ: brings three optical functions into one CubeSat design. It is being integrated in the lab and has not flown yet.
AlbaSpace/index.html.El diseño usa las estrellas como referen: The design uses stars as a reference to estimate orientation.
AlbaSpace/index.html.El diseño compara imágenes para separar: The design compares images to distinguish movement from the star background.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Al extender el baffle, el diseño cambia: Extending the baffle changes the design's view to study a nearby target.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Hablemos de tu misión por WhatsApp: Let's talk about your mission on WhatsApp
AlbaSpace/index.html.Concepto de Ark Light 1 integrado en un: Concept of Ark Light 1 integrated into a CubeSat above Earth
AlbaSpace/index.html.Concepto · Ilustración de integración; n: Concept · Integration illustration; not an actual mission
AlbaSpace/index.html.En una misión tradicional, orientarse, v: In a traditional mission, attitude determination, watching for space debris and docking with another vehicle require different cameras and equipment: more cost, more mass and more power. Our instrument runs all three algorithms in parallel, on a flight computer with a real-time operating system.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Resuelve solo el problema que en el espa: It solves on its own what is called the «lost in space» problem: knowing nothing beforehand, it photographs the sky, recognizes the stars and calculates its orientation.
AlbaSpace/index.html.El sensor expone un fotograma del cielo: The sensor exposes a frame of the sky and filters out noise and hot pixels.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Localiza cada punto brillante y calcula: It locates every bright point and calculates its center with sub-pixel precision.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Compara los triángulos que forman las má: It compares the triangles formed by the brightest ones with an onboard catalog.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Con las estrellas identificadas, obtiene: With the stars identified, it works out where the satellite is pointing, one to five times per second.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Simulación: un campo de estrellas donde: Simulation: a star field where the algorithm marks the centroids, joins the brightest into triangles, labels them from the catalog and calculates the orientation
AlbaSpace/index.html.Entre dos fotos seguidas las estrellas n: Between two consecutive photos the stars do not move, but debris and satellites do. The instrument subtracts one photo from the other, cleans up what is left over and keeps what moves: its position, heading and speed.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Simulación: un campo de estrellas con do: Simulation: a star field crossed by two objects; in the algorithm view the stars disappear and only the moving objects remain
AlbaSpace/index.html.El baffle no sólo protege de la luz. Al: The baffle does more than block light. Extending it moves the optics and changes the focal length: the same sensor goes from watching more than 20 degrees of sky to a close view of the vehicle it is about to dock with.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Simulación: a la izquierda el instrument: Simulation: on the left, the instrument from the side with its cone of view; on the right, what the sensor sees, getting closer to the target vehicle as the baffle extends
AlbaSpace/index.html.La computadora de vuelo, el sensor, la ó: The flight computer, the sensor, the optics and the telescopic baffle, piece by piece.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Un cubo para CubeSats de 3U a 12U: 175 g: A cube for 3U to 12U CubeSats: 175 g with the mechanism and 1.25 W. Scroll to open it.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Cada pieza sale de su lugar para ver cóm: Each part leaves its place so you can see how it fits inside.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Corre los tres algoritmos en paralelo, c: It runs all three algorithms in parallel, with a real-time operating system.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Una sola cámara para orientarse, detecta: A single camera to orient itself, detect space debris and dock.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Al extender el baffle se mueve y cambia: When the baffle extends, it moves and changes its focal length: from watching more than 20 degrees of sky to seeing up close.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Sus segmentos viajan plegados en menos d: Its segments travel stowed in less than 50 mm and block stray light in orbit.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Un circuito doble corta un hilo por calo: A dual circuit cuts a wire by heat and spring guides push each segment out.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Evitan que las piezas de metal se suelde: They keep the metal parts from welding together in a vacuum.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Ark Light 1, el Star Tracker de Alba Spa: Ark Light 1, the Alba Space Star Tracker, with its baffle stowed
AlbaSpace/index.html.Un baffle fijo ocupa volumen valioso en: A fixed baffle takes up valuable volume at launch. Ours travels stowed, less than 50 mm long, and extends once it reaches orbit.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Bloquea la luz parásita en órbita sin qu: It blocks stray light in orbit without taking space from the CubeSat payload: 0.13 dm³ stowed and 0.28 dm³ deployed.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Un circuito doble corta un hilo por calo: A dual circuit cuts a wire by heat and spring-loaded guides push each segment into place.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Bujes de teflón evitan que las piezas de: Teflon bushings keep the metal parts from cold-welding in vacuum, so it works after months in orbit.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Dibujo del instrumento con su baffle de: Drawing of the instrument with its three-segment baffle, which extends upward when deployed
AlbaSpace/index.html.Ark Light 1 montado en la cara de un Cub: Ark Light 1 mounted on the face of a 6U CubeSat, in orbit above the Earth
AlbaSpace/index.html.Apuntar con precisión y vigilar lo que p: Precise pointing and awareness of what happens around each satellite in the fleet, with no extra equipment.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Vigilar la basura espacial y ayudar a ev: Watching space debris and helping avoid collisions from orbit.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Un apuntamiento estable para instrumento: Stable pointing for demanding instruments, with little mass and little volume.
AlbaSpace/index.html.Imágenes de cerca para acercarse, inspec: Close-up images to approach, inspect and dock with another vehicle.
